config.title: Chat Model Provider for Amazon Bedrock
config.profile.description: AWS profile name in `~/.aws/config` (SSO supported). Required.
config.region.description: AWS region, for example `us-west-2`. Leave empty to use the region set in the profile.
config.modelVisibility.description: Model visibility settings shared by the configuration menu and JSON. The default selects Anthropic and OpenAI with no minimum version. `mode`: `all` includes future providers, while `selected` with an empty `providers` array selects none. Provider keys are foundation model namespaces; `moonshot` includes `moonshotai`, and `other` includes unrecognized namespaces. Optional `minimumVersions` accepts version strings for `claude`, `gpt` and `grok`; omit a key for no minimum. The menu asks only for selected providers, and saving a selected mode removes thresholds for unselected providers. A GPT minimum also hides GPT-OSS and Safeguard; unknown model versions remain visible and are marked when a minimum applies. Invalid settings are diagnosed and select no models. Workspace settings replace the User object completely; local/Remote User merging within User settings follows VS Code.
config.modelPresets.description: Fixed model presets shared by the management menu and JSON. Each item has `id` (a unique, stable string), `modelId` (the full foundation model ID, for example `openai.gpt-6-luna`), `route` (`Geo`, `Global` or `In-Region`) and `effort` (`default`, `off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`). The display name is generated from the model, effort and route, for example `Luna-Medium (Geo)`. A preset keeps its route and is not switched when `inferenceScope` changes. Items that share an `id`, or the same `modelId`, `route` and `effort`, are rejected. An empty or missing array means no presets; workspace settings replace the User array completely. Presets are not yet listed in the Chat model picker.
config.inferenceScope.description: Which cross-Region inference profile to use. Requests are processed only within the chosen scope.
config.inferenceScope.geo: Geographic profile (for example `us.` or `eu.`, based on your region). Data stays within that geography. Models that only offer a global profile are hidden.
config.inferenceScope.global: Global profile. Requests may be processed in any AWS Region worldwide. Falls back to the geographic profile when a model has no global profile.
config.usageResetDay.description: Day of the month (1–31) when the token usage totals reset. If a month has fewer days, the reset happens on its last day.
config.usageResetHour.description: Hour (UTC, 0–23) when the token usage totals reset.
config.customPricing.description: Your own prices in USD per 1M tokens, keyed by model ID. These override the downloaded prices (the public AWS price list, then the price tables on AWS model cards). `cacheRead` and `cacheWrite` are optional prompt cache prices; without them, costs for requests that read or write the prompt cache are not estimated. Custom prices have no long-context tier, so costs for requests above a model's long-context threshold are not estimated. Example: `{ "openai.gpt-6-astra": { "input": 5, "output": 20 } }`
